name: Sunflower Seed Butter
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as sunflower seeds are naturally low FODMAP and don't feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Choose natural varieties without added inulin or chicory root fiber
Store in refrigerator after opening to prevent rancidity
Stir well before use as natural separation is normal
Check labels for high-FODMAP additives like honey or agave
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin E and magnesium
Good source of healthy monounsaturated fats
